mapper.sql: r.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND r.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (r.effective_from IS NULL OR r.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT c.* FROM com_contract c JOIN com_project_contract_relation r ON r.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND r.contract_id = c.id WHERE c.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND ORDER BY c.contract_no, c.id

SELECT DISTINCT o.* FROM com_sales_order o JOIN com_order_contract_relation oc ON oc.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND oc.order_id = o.id AND oc.deleted = 0 AND oc.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (oc.effective_to IS NULL OR oc.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) JOIN com_project_contract_relation r ON r.tenant_id = oc.tenant_id AND r.contract_id = oc.contract_id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND o.deleted = 0 AND ORDER BY o.order_create_time, o.id
SELECT * FROM com_crm_execution_order WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND primary_project_id = #{query.projectId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY execution_no, id
